No broader discovery or source refresh is authorized by this batch. Keep one worker, fixed project identity, five-second spacing, Retry-After, and blocked-state stops. Retrieved through the previously configured project HTTP relay. Canonical NTVMR endpoint and actual transport URL are retained separately.
